previous_last_sync.summary: All three commits are CI and repository-maintenance changes: the software workflows now run on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 runners, the firmware build installs its own dependencies and uses the bundled ARM binutils, and the pull request merge adds no further changes. No firmware behavior, tune layout, flashing procedure, or builder-facing build script changed, so no documentation update is required.

decisions.rationale: The software workflows were moved from a self-hosted runner label to GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 runners, with Java 21 and build packages installed inside the job. This affects only how Capoworks CI jobs are executed; firmware behavior, artifacts for users, and local build instructions are unchanged.

last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU restored Frankenso configuration generation and fixed the Windows simulator build. Builders generating Frankenso configuration now use the f407-discovery board metadata for the host-only module profile, and the simulator's batch-order test now compiles on Windows.

decisions.rationale: Capoworks ECU restored Frankenso configuration generation: gen_config_board.sh now resolves the host-only module profile against the f407-discovery board metadata when the board directory is config/boards/frankenso, because Frankenso has no board.mk of its own. Config generation itself still uses the Frankenso board directory. Builders generating Frankenso configuration no longer need a manual workaround; no tune, flashing, or runtime behavior changes. The simulator's SleepExecutor batch-order test now casts its expected and actual callback counts to int for the firmwareError format, so the Windows simulator build compiles. This is a test-only change with no effect on simulator or ECU behavior.
evidence: firmware/gen_config_board.sh: added PROFILE_BOARD_DIR=$BOARD_DIR and a case on BOARD_DIR_NORMALIZED matching config/boards/frankenso or */config/boards/frankenso to set PROFILE_BOARD_DIR to the sibling f407-discovery directory
firmware/gen_config_board.sh: module-profile make invocation now passes BOARD_DIR="$PROFILE_BOARD_DIR" while config generation still passes -board ${BOARD_DIR}
firmware/gen_config_board.sh: comment states Frankenso builds with f407-discovery board metadata and has no board.mk
simulator/simulator/rusEfiFunctionalTest.cpp: assertBatchOrder firmwareError format changed from %zu to %d with static_cast<int> on expectedCount and context->callbackCount
